Publication in *Analytical Chemistry* of the invited review **“Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy Imaging for Material and Biomedical Applications: Recent Advances and Future Perspectives.”**

The review covers technical fundamentals, industrial and geological applications, biomedical imaging, chemometrics and future developments.

DOI: [10.1021/acs.analchem.2c04910](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.analchem.2c04910).
